turns.text: I'd like a 5-second widescreen clip of rain on a neon-lit street, with rain sounds, using Veo 3 only. The picker labels it paid and quotes 80 credits for this clip. I'm on the free tier, so check with me before spending anything.

dialog.agent:
Veo 3 is marked paid, so it can’t run on your current free-tier account—even if you approve the quoted 80 credits.

I haven’t started a job or spent any credits, and I won’t substitute another model. Would you like to upgrade first and keep your requested 5-second widescreen neon-rain clip with rain sounds?
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

dialog.agent: Veo still won’t run on your free plan. Does “something rather than nothing” mean you’re okay switching to **LTX 2.5 at 480p** for the same 5-second widescreen neon-lit street clip with rain sounds? That would use credits; I haven’t spent any yet.
dialog.user: No, please don’t switch models—I want Veo 3 only, even if that means we can’t make the clip on my free tier. I haven’t approved spending any credits, so please keep everything on hold. The picker quotes 80 credits for the Veo 3 clip, which is why I wanted you to check with me first.

turns.agent:
Understood—everything is on hold. No generation has started and no credits have been spent.

Your request remains **Veo 3 only**: a 5-second widescreen neon-lit rainy street clip with rain sounds. I won’t switch models or spend the quoted 80 credits without your explicit approval, and Veo requires an eligible paid plan.
